source_provider: Same fixed full PARI rational M2(867) basis, same exact product recipes, original u/lambda and every final certificate from R892/R899
auxiliary_prime_policy: In public Actions only, choose the first prime in the interval with complete cubic splitting, unit input denominators and full original basis rank. No promise this finite search succeeds.
precision_policy: Reuse the exact base chart and previous fully checked prime-power solution. All original rows are checked after every precision stage. No coordinate-height bound is assumed.
output_policy: Public Actions console only; persist source, request, run and hashes, no generated coefficients/matrices/artifacts/releases.
